<details><summary><code>client.<a href="src/fern/client.py#L391-L427">add_jobs</a>(...) -> typing.List[Job]</code></summary>
<dl>
<dd>

#### 📝 Description

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

The endpoint for adding new jobs
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>

#### 🔌 Usage

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

```python
from fern import FernApi, Job
from fern.environment import FernApiEnvironment

client = FernApi(
    environment=FernApiEnvironment.DEFAULT,
)

client.add_jobs(
    request=[
        Job(
            institution_id=1,
            repository_base_url="repositoryBaseURL",
            metadata_prefix="metadataPrefix",
            sets=[
                "sets"
            ],
            schedule_cron_expression="0 5 * * 1",
        )
    ],
)

```
